info.title: daqifi-mcp — Model Context Protocol server for DAQiFi devices
info.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for DAQiFi Nyquist data-acquisition devices. Lets an AI agent discover, connect, configure channels, and run on-device SD-card logging.

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Expose discovery/introspection only; block configuration and logging.

options.name: --max-sample-rate-hz
options.description: Clamp set_sample_rate requests to at most <n> Hz.
